sagarin_battery_large_divergence_coverag.plain_summary: When Jeff Sagarins ratings disagreed with the betting line by three points or more in 2010-2016, his side covered a bit more often than not. This version drops the one season whose ratings archive is still mostly missing, so every season in it is measured on comparable footing.
